_note: Scripted receptionists for VOICE_MODE=mock, keyed by clinic id from clinics.json. Lines follow the prototype SCENARIO with the product rules applied: the agent says it is an AI on every call, speaks only redacted facts and never asks to hold or book before approval. at_ms is time since the call started. result is the structured call_result; status and chips come from it, never from the lines.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling for a patient. Do you take Delta Dental?

lines.speaker: clinic
lines.text: Yes, we do. A cleaning is $95 with Delta.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. Anything Tuesday afternoon or Thursday morning?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. I'll check with the patient and call back to book.

booking_reply.evidence: Clinic said: You're all set for Thursday at 9:30.
